Responsibilities: Experience in medicine sales: minimum 5 years Need to do software sales. Create new customers and achieve sales targets. Duty for 10 hours Eat and stay on your own. It's better to remain unmarried. Male candidates will be hired.

Requirements: Must have experience in medicine sales Must sell medicine in software Must have the desire to create new customers and achieve sales targets
